flyer.headline: First harvest. This is what farmers said.
flyer.lead_html: 18 farms in Abia State tested 6 cassava varieties on their own land in 2025. Each farm grew three of them, A, B and C, and said which was best and worst.
flyer.callout_html: Biggie and Baba-70 were liked best by most farmers, on yield and overall. Poundable was liked for taste but gave less. The order is still preliminary, so answers from the 7 farms we have not heard from count double.
flyer.basis_note: Based on 11 farms with harvest answers. The order is preliminary and gets more reliable with more answers.
flyer.band_title: Thank you to everyone who sent their answers.
flyer.band_html: The results get more reliable with every answer. Next season, go to climmob.net and use the QR code for your package.
flyer.page2_intro: How the varieties did on each trait through the season, compared with the others.
flyer.symbols_note: The symbols show the chance that the option beats an average option (++ above 70 %, + above 58 %, − below 42 %, −− below 30 %). The order follows "liked best overall". n is the number of farms with valid answers. Traits with too few answers are left out.
flyer.how_html: 1 Go to the field and look at the three options A, B and C.   2 For each trait, say which was best and which was worst.   3 Go to climmob.net and use the QR code for your package. You get your own farm report back.

workshop.title: Feedback workshop
workshop.audience: participants of one village or cluster, 10 to 25 people
workshop.priority: the handover of the sheets and certificates, then the peer interviews.
rules: Rotate roles if short on staff. Observers can also prompt during peer interviews.
There are no wrong answers, especially in the read-aloud and pictogram parts.
Keep time, but allow space for honest reflection when the group is engaged.

steps.title: Kick-off
steps.intro: Short welcome. Who we are, why we are here, how long it takes.

steps.title: The concluded trial
steps.intro: Explain the objective, the process and the scope of the trial. Remind everyone that each farm tested three options out of 6, assigned at random.

steps.title: Feedback sheet explanation and handover
steps.intro: Explain the structure and purpose of the farmer feedback sheet and hand one to each participant.
bullets: Go through one sheet section by section. The three options, the own ranking next to the ranking of everyone, the position of the options in the full ranking.
Ask participants to find their own best option on the sheet and read it aloud.
Explain that the results are the farmers' own judgements, not measured yield.

steps.title: Group discussion by preference
steps.intro: Divide participants into small groups by the option they ranked first.
bullets: Why did you choose this option? What stood out in its performance?
How did the trial results match your expectations?
What are your next steps with what you learned?
Make sure each group member has a chance to speak.

steps.title: Group presentations
bullets: Each group presents its top preferences and the reasoning behind them.
Invite questions and comments from the other groups.

steps.title: Overall results
steps.intro: Present the results of the whole trial in a simple visual format, using the community flyer.
bullets: Explain why every farm tested a different set of three, and why that gives valid results for all options together.
Emphasise that the trial involved 18 farms. It is a community effort.
State clearly that the tested options may not be released or available for some time.

steps.title: Certificate handover
steps.intro: Hand the certificate of participation to each farmer. Call them by name.

steps.title: Net promoter score
steps.intro: Ask: how likely are you to recommend this feedback sheet and session to another farmer, from 0 to 10? Collect the answers on a show of hands or on paper.

steps.title: Closing
steps.intro: Thank participants for their time and contributions. Say what happens next and when they hear from the project again.

materials: One feedback sheet per participant, plus a few blank copies
Flip chart or printed results for step 6
Pens and paper for the net promoter score
